name: opendss_altdss_library

support_targets.opendss: EPRI OpenDSS; online documentation is mixed-version

validation.source_review: Line/LineCode and Phase 3A passed independent QA/QC and required corrections are applied. The owner accepted Phase 3B packages 1 through 4 after independent QA/QC and architect review. Package 5 (Capacitor) passed coder validation, independent QA/QC (PASS, no required corrections), and the architect review (PASS WITH FINDINGS: E-1 states-row wording, E-2 undisclosed EPRI default divergence, A-1 and A-2 architect handoff corrections, O-1 eight unvalidated row fields), and awaits the owner's disposition. Package 6 (Generator) is delivered and gated on that disposition.
validation.schema_validation: tools/validate_catalogs.py passed 14/14 manifest and catalog schema pairs (Draft 2020-12 with format checking, jsonschema 4.26.0) when last run on 2026-11-22.
validation.runtime: All 12 catalogued examples ran successfully on the pinned stack on Windows 11 AMD64, Python 3.14.6, altdss 0.2.4, dss-python 0.15.7, and backend 0.14.5; the harness was last re-run on 2026-11-22. Phase 3B packages 1 through 5 have readback matrices covering their catalogued fields and focused behavior probes; the package-5 matrix reproduced byte-identically apart from the environment block during the architect audit.

known_gaps: Three catalog files are still empty pending later phases: opendss_objects, python_interface_comparison, troubleshooting.

The generated altdss_python_api catalog covers object and collection classes and the AltDSS context. Non-element context interfaces, context batch proxies, and internal _str proxies are outside the catalog scope.

dss_capi.json covers Line, LineCode, LineGeometry, LineSpacing, WireData, CNData, TSData, Circuit creation, Vsource, Transformer, XfmrCode, Load, and Capacitor, including inherited fields used in these packages.
Transformer and XfmrCode coverage is limited to two and three windings. AutoTrans is deferred pending an owner scope decision.
LoadShape and GrowthShape property catalogs are deferred. The Load package covers the Load element and its shape-assignment behavior only.
Property-level source_refs remain partial for Line/LineCode (E-3 deferred); new element packages require per-row citations.
Fixture-based validation with IEEE 13- and 34-node circuits and golden results is planned for Phase 4; no golden fixtures exist yet.
The beta package line (AltDSS-Python 0.3.0b2 and later) is documented as future compatibility only and not validated.
EPRI online pages do not state one OpenDSS version; version-sensitive claims need release-specific confirmation.
The legacy line catalog and builder are retained for provenance and are not active inputs.
CapControl is a deferred controller catalog. The Capacitor package covers the Capacitor element and the States control hook only.
The Capacitor element has no Spectrum property, unlike Load and Vsource.

element_properties.schema.json allows undeclared row fields, so the Load catalog's enum_type and reference_class entries are unvalidated until the shared schema declares them (phase3b_load_architect_audit O-1).
GenDispatcher, CapControl, InvControl, PVSystem and Storage are deferred controller or element catalogs; the element packages cover element behavior and control hooks only.
Generator dispatch properties (DispMode, DispValue, Status, ForceOn, PVFactor) act through the deferred GenDispatcher control, so their effects are source-described rather than runtime-demonstrated.
next_actions: Disposition Phase 3B package 5 (Capacitor). Independent QA/QC and the architect review both report pass; the owner decides whether findings E-1 (states-row wording) and E-2 (undisclosed EPRI default divergence) are applied first.
Deliver Phase 3B package 6 (Generator) per docs/handoffs/Phase_3B_Generator_Coder_handoff.md once the owner dispositions package 5.

Declare the eight element row fields that packages 4 and 5 use (enum_type, array_element_type, array_length, readback_type, python_write_status, python_creation_status, python_method, dss_text_write) in the shared element schema, or drop them, so the row fields stop being unvalidated (load O-1, capacitor O-1).
Draft the Phase 4 golden fixture layout and harness before the first fixture is added.
